# Bloomberg reports on the growing use of legal finance in healthcare disputes


October 1, 2024


-
-
-
-


In an article entitled "Hospitals Seen as Potential Growth Area for Litigation Financing," Bloomberg reports on remarks made by Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) describing how the legal finance industry could see new demand from an increasing number of health care lawsuits.
